content:
You plan to visit 7 European cities for 20 days in total. You only take direct flights to commute between cities. You plan to stay in Stuttgart for 3 days. You have to attend a workshop in Stuttgart between day 11 and day 13. You want to spend 4 days in Edinburgh. You want to spend 4 days in Athens. You would like to visit Split for 2 days. You would like to meet your friends at Split between day 13 and day 14 to tour together. You would like to visit Krakow for 4 days. You want to meet a friend in Krakow between day 8 and day 11. You want to spend 5 days in Venice. You want to spend 4 days in Mykonos.

Here are the cities that have direct flights:
Krakow and Split, Split and Athens, Edinburgh and Krakow, Venice and Stuttgart, Krakow and Stuttgart, Edinburgh and Stuttgart, Stuttgart and Athens, Venice and Edinburgh, Athens and Mykonos, Venice and Athens, Stuttgart and Split, Edinburgh and Athens.

Find a trip plan of visiting the cities for 20 days by taking direct flights to commute between them.

Please output the trip plan in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"day_range": "Day X-Y", "place": "<CITY>"}]}. Include all city visits with their day ranges. Do not include separate flight entries in the JSON output.

IMPORTANT: When you fly from city A to city B on day X, that day counts for BOTH cities. For example:
- If you stay in Venice from Day 1-3 and fly to Vienna on Day 3, then:
  - Venice: Day 1-3 (3 days)
  - Vienna: Day 3-6 (4 days, including the flight day)
- The flight day (Day 3) is counted for both Venice and Vienna.
- Do NOT create separate flight entries in the JSON.

{
  "itinerary": [
    { "day_range": "Day 1-5", "place": "Venice" },
    { "day_range": "Day 5-8", "place": "Edinburgh" },
    { "day_range": "Day 8-11", "place": "Krakow" },
    { "day_range": "Day 11-13", "place": "Stuttgart" },
    { "day_range": "Day 13-14", "place": "Split" },
    { "day_range": "Day 14-17", "place": "Athens" },
    { "day_range": "Day 17-20", "place": "Mykonos" }
  ]
} 

/* Explanation:
   • The trip uses exactly 7 segments with durations equal to the required days:
       – Venice: 5 days (Day 1–5)
       – Edinburgh: 4 days (Day 5–8). Flight from Venice to Edinburgh on Day 5 (overlap).
       – Krakow: 4 days (Day 8–11). The friend‐meeting window (Day 8–11) in Krakow is met.
       – Stuttgart: 3 days (Day 11–13). The workshop (between Day 11 and 13) is scheduled here.
       – Split: 2 days (Day 13–14). The Split segment covers Day 13–14 so you can meet your friends.
       – Athens: 4 days (Day 14–17)
       – Mykonos: 4 days (Day 17–20)
   • Flight connections (on the overlapping days) follow direct routes:
       – Venice → Edinburgh (direct via “Venice and Edinburgh”)
       – Edinburgh → Krakow (“Edinburgh and Krakow”)
       – Krakow → Stuttgart (“Krakow and Stuttgart”)
       – Stuttgart → Split (“Stuttgart and Split”)
       – Split → Athens (“Split and Athens”)
       – Athens → Mykonos (“Athens and Mykonos”)
   • Note that on each flight day the day counts for both the departing and arriving cities, so the durations add up to 26 days in segments but 6 overlapping flight days make the total actual trip 20 days.
   
This itinerary satisfies all the conditions and uses only the listed direct flights.  */
